notes.title: Japanese Update
notes.notes:
Translations for the Japanese language have been improved.
 Some minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Russian Patch
notes.notes:
Translations for Russian language have been improved.
 A few minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Patch
notes.notes:
Translations for simplified Chinese language have been improved.
 A few minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The problems with the order we prepared for Room 8 have been resolved.
 Fixed issues with the floor cleaning mission. (including garbage disposal)
 The objectives at the top were made clear when Esc was pressed.
 Helpful messages added.
 Added indicators to note paper and corkboard.
 The stuck problem that occurred when we went to NPCs was fixed.
 Font incompatibilities in Chinese, Korean and Japanese languages have been resolved.
 We are working to improve Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Russian translations. It will be released in a few days.


 Thank you for the comments from our players. Taking these into consideration, we continue to work to further improve our game.
